verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against the Ammonites . . . and prophesy against them

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֡ה אָמַ֣ר יַעַן֩ אָמְרֵ֨ךְ הֶאָ֜ח אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֣י כִֽי־ נִחָ֗ל וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּ֣י נָשַׁ֔מָּה וְאֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֥י הָלְכ֖וּ בַּגּוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā liḇ·nê ‘am·mō·wn šim·‘ū də·ḇar- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an ’ā·mə·rêḵ he·’āḥ ’el- miq·dā·šî ḵî- ni·ḥāl wə·’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî nā·šam·māh wə·’el- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh kî hā·lə·ḵū bag·gō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Tell the Ammonites . . . to hear the word of the Lord GOD for this is what the Lord GOD says Because you exclaimed Aha when My sanctuary - was profaned - when the land of Israel - was laid waste and when the house of Judah - went into exile

verses.original: לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נֹתְנָ֨ךְ לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֗ה לִבְנֵי־ קֶ֜דֶם וְיִשְּׁב֤וּ טִירֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְנָ֥תְנוּ מִשְׁכְּנֵיהֶ֑ם בָ֖ךְ הֵ֚מָּה יֹאכְל֣וּ פִרְיֵ֔ךְ וְהֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁתּ֥וּ חֲלָבֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî nō·ṯə·nāḵ lə·mō·w·rā·šāh liḇ·nê- qe·ḏem wə·yiš·šə·ḇū ṭî·rō·w·ṯê·hem bāḵ wə·nā·ṯə·nū miš·kə·nê·hem ḇāḵ hêm·māh yō·ḵə·lū p̄ir·yêḵ wə·hêm·māh yiš·tū ḥă·lā·ḇêḵ
verses.literal: therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you They will eat your fruit . . . and drink your milk

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ רַבָּה֙ לִנְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְמִרְבַּץ־ צֹ֑אן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- rab·bāh lin·wêh ḡə·mal·lîm wə·’eṯ- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn lə·mir·baṣ- ṣōn wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will make - Rabbah a pasture for camels and - Ammon a resting place for sheep Then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֚עַן מַחְאֲךָ֣ יָ֔ד וְרַקְעֲךָ֖ בְּרָ֑גֶל וַתִּשְׂמַ֤ח אֶל־ אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ בְּכָל־ שָֽׁאטְךָ֙
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an maḥ·’ă·ḵā yāḏ wə·raq·‘ă·ḵā bə·rā·ḡel wat·tiś·maḥ ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl bə·ne·p̄eš bə·ḵāl šā·ṭə·ḵā
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Because you clapped your hands and stomped your feet and rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of contempt

verses.original: לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֤יךָֽ־ לְבַג לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךָ מִן־ הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî nā·ṭî·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā- lə·ḇaḡ lag·gō·w·yim wə·hiḵ·rat·tî·ḵā min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā min- hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’aš·mî·ḏə·ḵā wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: therefore I will indeed stretch out - My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations I will cut you off from the peoples and exterminate you from the countries I will destroy you and you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אָמַ֖ר יַ֗עַן מוֹאָב֙ וְשֵׂעִ֔יר אֲמֹ֤ר הִנֵּ֥ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃ כְּכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an mō·w·’āḇ wə·śê·‘îr ’ă·mōr hin·nêh bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh kə·ḵāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because Moab and Seir said Look the house of Judah is like all the other nations

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ הִנְנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־ כֶּ֤תֶף מוֹאָב֙ מִקָּצֵ֑הוּ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים מֵֽעָרָ֖יו בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁימֹ֔ת בַּ֥עַל מְע֖וֹן וְקִרְיָתְמָה׃ צְבִ֗י אֶ֚רֶץ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî p̄ō·ṯê·aḥ ’eṯ- ke·ṯep̄ mō·w·’āḇ miq·qā·ṣê·hū mê·he·‘ā·rîm mê·‘ā·rāw bêṯ hay·šî·mōṯ ba·‘al mə·‘ō·wn wə·qir·yå̄·ṯə·må̄h ṣə·ḇî ’e·reṣ
verses.literal: therefore I will indeed expose - the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities . . . vvv Beth-jeshimoth vvv Baal-meon and Kiriathaim the glory of the land

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֖יהָ עַל־ לִבְנֵי־ עַמּ֔וֹן לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה בְּנֵ֣י קֶ֙דֶם֙ לְמַ֛עַן בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן לֹֽא־ תִזָּכֵ֥ר בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hā ‘al- liḇ·nê- ‘am·mō·wn lə·mō·w·rā·šāh bə·nê qe·ḏem lə·ma·‘an bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn lō- ṯiz·zā·ḵêr bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: I will give it along with vvv the Ammonites as a possession to the people of the East so that vvv the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations

verses.original: אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּבְמוֹאָ֖ב וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.literal: So I will execute judgments on Moab and they will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֣עַן אֱד֛וֹם עֲשׂ֥וֹת בִּנְקֹ֥ם נָקָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וְנִקְּמ֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃ וַיֶּאְשְׁמ֥וּ אָשׁ֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ‘ă·śō·wṯ bin·qōm nā·qām lə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·niq·qə·mū ḇā·hem way·ye’·šə·mū ’ā·šō·wm
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because Edom acted vengefully . . . against the house of Judah and in [so doing] . . . incurred grievous guilt . . .

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ וְנָטִ֤תִי יָדִי֙ עַל־ אֱד֔וֹם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֣ם וּבְהֵמָ֑ה וּנְתַתִּ֤יהָ חָרְבָּה֙ מִתֵּימָ֔ן וּדְדָ֖נֶה יִפֹּֽלוּ׃ בַּחֶ֥רֶב
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar wə·nā·ṭi·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hā ḥā·rə·bāh mit·tê·mān ū·ḏə·ḏā·neh yip·pō·lū ba·ḥe·reḇ
verses.literal: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast I will make it a wasteland and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֜י בֶּאֱד֗וֹם בְּיַד֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעָשׂ֣וּ בֶאֱד֔וֹם כְּאַפִּ֖י וְכַחֲמָתִ֑י וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯî be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm bə·yaḏ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘ā·śū ḇe·’ĕ·ḏō·wm kə·’ap·pî wə·ḵa·ḥă·mā·ṯî wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will take - My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and wrath Then they will know - My vengeance declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֛עַן פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים עֲשׂ֥וֹת בִּנְקָמָ֑ה וַיִּנָּקְמ֤וּ נָקָם֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַשְׁחִ֖ית עוֹלָֽם׃ אֵיבַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an pə·liš·tîm ‘ă·śō·wṯ bin·qā·māh way·yin·nā·qə·mū nā·qām biš·’āṭ bə·ne·p̄eš lə·maš·ḥîṯ ‘ō·w·lām ’ê·ḇaṯ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because the Philistines acted in vengeance taking vengeance with malice of soul to destroy [Judah] with ancient hostility

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ הִנְנִ֨י נוֹטֶ֤ה יָדִי֙ עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת־ כְּרֵתִ֑ים וְהַ֣אֲבַדְתִּ֔י אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית ח֥וֹף הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî nō·w·ṭeh yā·ḏî ‘al- pə·liš·tîm wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’eṯ- kə·rê·ṯîm wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî ’eṯ- šə·’ê·rîṯ ḥō·wp̄ hay·yām
verses.literal: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines and I will cut off - the Cherethites and destroy - the remnant along the coast

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתִי גְּדֹל֔וֹת נְקָמ֣וֹת בָם֙ חֵמָ֑ה בְּתוֹכְח֖וֹת וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֥י אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ nə·qā·mō·wṯ ḇām ḥê·māh bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḥō·wṯ wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·ṯit·tî ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯî bām
verses.literal: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof Then they will know that I am the LORD when I lay - My vengeance upon them
